title: Fix Arc Preview and Output
description: The arc command doesn't preview correctly (no curve rendering for arc/circle-outline preview kinds) and produces wrong output (kernel reads radiusPoint instead of start)
summary: Fixed multi-tab mode dock chrome: grid columns now order active tab → gap → sibling tabs so body spans active+gap only (not under inactive tabs). Reordered tab bar DOM to match. Disabled full bg-active-base fill on stacked tabs so the primary stroke uses border classes only.
